collection.description: Two elders remember an old conflict differently; younger villagers want a simple story with heroes and villains.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (elder1) and (elder2), two elders, remember an old conflict differently; younger villagers want a simple story with heroes and villains.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: The elders agree on some facts but not their meaning.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: One admits that fear distorted what they remember.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: (elder1), a veteran, explains why protecting people mattered.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: Another explains the lasting cost of fighting.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: (teen) asks whether refusing an unjust order is brave.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: (child) receives a brief, reassuring explanation without graphic detail.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: The elders agree that future generations deserve more than a tidy legend.
